notes.title: Versebound Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hiiohoi!

We've been enjoying the sun lately, there's been like 4 sunny days already (double the amount compared to last year)! We've also gotten over 50 reviews on Steam, thus achieving the "Very Positive" status, which is absolutely fantastic and amazing! It's been so nice to read about people's experiences with VB. We've also gotten feedback on our Discord and Steam Discussions. While we are at the holidays at the moment, we found time to do a small patch to fix a few little things.

The stuff

 fixed a text bug about Poem of Vaski damage reduction percentage
 fixed a bug where the pointer arrow to Weapon Imbue Altar would spawn to the origin of Tapiola upon gaining Väki


Cya around and enjoy the summer, everyone! And watch for the Sääski!

notes.title: Versebound Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Moikka!

Versebound has been out for a month now, and we've gotten lots of feedback, which has been great! Many of you have also given us ideas for improvements in terms of quality of life options and balance. We managed to implement most of the requested things in this patch, along with some bug fixes. Controller support was also on the list, and we tried our best to implement it, but in the end it proved too difficult with the current logic in the game. We did learn many things by digging in to the possibilities on that front, so for our future games we'll for sure manage it easily as we'll be able to design it in properly from the start. :)

But anyway, here are the patch notes!

Balance:

 Reduced Tapio’s HP
 Reduced the amount of Trial of Mielikki mushrooms in Tuonela
 Reduced the XP multiplier of Luonto
 Ukko's Wedge rotation speed fade out time prolonged
 Etiäinen taunting shadow lifetime up
 Triggering Snowshoes of kauppi is now easier
 Shortened Aino Skill end animation duration -> now resuming movement is faster
 Reduced Aino Skill cooldowns across all levels
 Poem of Henki now also heals for 2HP upon updating max health
 Increased Poem of Henki weapon damage +%
 Poem of Hurme HP per kill per level increased
 Increased Poem of Vaski dmg reduction %
 Harpoon knockback down across all levels
 Harpoon damage up across all levels (except imbued)
 Bear Trap lv 1-5 damage down
 Bear Trap lv 1-5 cooldowns up slightly
 Vengeful Tears trail lifespan slightly up
 Spirit of Kaleva base damage up
 Spirit of Kaleva damage increase upon player hit down
 Pike Jawbone damage up across all levels
 Northern Breeze lv 4-5 & imbued knockback down
 Northern Breeze lv 1-5 rotation speed down
 Northern Breeze damage up across all levels


Quality of life settings:

 Added an option to aim the Skill to movement direction
 Added an option to toggle a visible attack direction indicator
 Added an option to toggle enemy hit indicators
 Added an option to reroll upgrades once per level


Bug fixes:

 Arrow to stone altar now correctly disappears if no Väki is left after opening the door in Tuonela unlock
 Fixed a bug where pause menu could be opened before the scene has faded
 Fixed a bug where picking up a Tuonela ritual flower exactly when the ritual is failed resets the timer and bugs out the ritual
 Maybe fixed a bug where player might get stuck in the level borders
 Maybe fixed a bug where harpoon might stop attacking upon reaching near 0% cooldown
 Maybe fixed a bug where Tuonela's river might stop damaging player after Cloudberry invulnerability effect ends


Other:

 Reworded Ilmarinen’s first task to be more clear
 Reframed some text info in settings menu to be more clear
 Tuonela unlock should now be less confusing
 Whitecurrants now drop with a higher chance
 Invulnerability duration can now be prolonged upon eating another Cloudberry when invulnerability is active

notes.title: Demo update & Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
We are taking part in the Steam Next Fest that started TODAY!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780665/e0e557bc56fe067e61ae332ec0219c76839c06b7.png
Go check out some of those sweet demos and upcoming games and see if you can spot Versebound in there ;) And if you haven't already, now is the perfect time to test out our demo, since we have a treat for you:

We are introducing a completely new way of progression to Versebound! 
It's something a bit crazy, something our community didn't expect, but also something that has been requested a lot! We are bringing stat based meta progression to the world of Kalevala! We've been really happy with the balance of the game, and it has served our hardcore audience well. On the other hand, most of the new players we've gotten feedback from have mentioned the game being too hard. And everyone who has ever balanced anything knows that it's always a subjective matter, it's always unbalanced to someone. 
The core idea of Versebound is, and has always been, to progress through skill and knowledge, by learning through every defeat and getting a bit farther every time. And we don't want to stray from that path. So, we came up with our own way to add stat based meta progression into the mix. Something that still keeps the game challenging to the hardcore audience, but also makes it more approachable for the players who enjoy grinding for stats as well! It's our way of doing it, and we are pretty psyched about it! We haven't yet had actual unbiased testers try it out though, so let's see how everyone likes it! We are not going to explain it further than that, play the game and find out how it works! 😊

On other news, there's now also environmental sounds in the Hub! Audio is an amazing way to bring the gaming experience alive, and we for sure want our game to feel immersive! We are keen to hear your feedback about this new addition as well.

On other other news, we've also made some minor tweaks to the game, like small bug and text fixes, and added some UI juice too!

The bug that causes some seemingly random, yet dramatic lag spikes is being inspected, hopefully we'll find the solution to that soon as well!

Have fun with the new update and let us know what you think :)

notes.title: Closed Playtest & Next Fest Update!
notes.notes:
Hello from the land of winter (actually it’s still summer here)!

We’ve been hard at work creating new content for Versebound, and pieces are slowly but surely starting to be where they’re supposed to. Story has been written, lots of amazing art has been created, and we’ve implemented more challenging bosses, new weapons and some completely new mechanics!

Soon, in October to be exact, we are ready to playtest big time again! Our original plan was to release a new public demo for the October Next Fest, but due to learning a bit more about marketing, we’ve decided to postpone our Next Fest application closer to the launch. So, if you want to try a public demo, it will be available during the first Next Fest of 2025, going from February 24 to March 3.

However, our schedule hasn’t changed. We’ll still have a nice demo for any and every enthusiastic bullet heaven enjoyer and Kalevala fanatic to try out! All you have to do is to join our Discord channel and vote “YES” to a poll on a channel named “polls”, and we’ll invite you to our super secret group of playtesters. During October, we’ll release the demo in this group and you’ll be free to try it out and through your optional feedback, affect the game Versebound will be in its final form! So, if you don't want to wait, join our Discord channel to try out a new demo of Versebound in October of 2024!

Click here to join our Discord!

We’ll look forward to meet you on the interwebs, and hope you’ll enjoy the things we’ve been cooking lately!

Byeeee! :)

notes.title: Version Update 240123 / The actually final demo update!
notes.notes:
So, the earlier patch (version 240116) was supposed to be the final update for the first demo of Versebound. But, to borrow and make our own version of a classic proverb: Balance.. Balance never changes.

All this of course means that we weren’t happy enough with the balance changes introduced in the last update. The idea was to make the game more accessible for a larger audience, not only for the hardcore gamers. However, we might’ve made the game a bit too easy.

To crack this case, we decided to try out a feature we’ve had in mind for the future updates of Versebound: Trials! Trials are difficulty modifiers that fundamentally change the gameplay, giving players unique challenges that spice up the gaming experience. We feel that this is a great opportunity to test this feature, so all feedback relating to the subject is greatly appreciated!

We also did some tweaks and updates to other stuff as well, you can read about those below.

Now we will (again) declare that this is the actually final version of the first demo of Versebound!
Happy adventures in the world where verses wield power!

Detailed patch notes

 Introduced Trials
 Added animations to Tapio’s minions
 Tweaked Tapio’s minion spawn specs and minion stats
 Reduced damage reduction of Poem of Sturdiness
 Reduced healing regeneration of Poem of Recovery
 Reduced poem damage bonuses a bit
 Reduced Arrows of Ilmatar damage
 Reduced Vengeful Tears slow amounts a bit
 Tweaked enemy spawn system to make the basic difficulty a bit harder
 Small text, visual and other updates

notes.title: Version Update 240116 & Future Plans!
notes.notes:
For this final patch of our first demo, we went through the feedback we’ve gotten so far, and took the opinions of the amazing people who tried the demo as a starting point for the changes we’d make. We focused on working on what’s already there, since for this demo we didn’t feel that it would be smart to introduce completely new gameplay mechanics. We did make a small exception though, more of that later!

The first main point of this patch is the balance. Overall, we felt that for most players the game was too difficult. Second, there were some rather great difficulty spikes along the duration of the level, since the power gap of normal weapons and imbued weapons was very big. Third, players felt that the overall balance of poems was quite off, some being much better than others. Same went for the weapons. So, we completely revamped the balance, and almost all weapons and poems went through some changes. Generally the game also became quite a lot easier, the point of this is to make it more accessible for more players. In the future, experienced players will be able to add challenge to the gameplay through various difficulty modifiers, gaining some nice rewards along the way!

The balance update in a nutshell

 Bridged the gap between normal and imbued weapons: buffed most normal weapons, and nerfed most imbued weapons
 Tweaked the spawning specs of the level to make it easier, and also to follow a more linear difficulty curve
 To balance the poems, now each poem level also gives %-based boost to all weapon damage. The amount varies, depending on the initial effect of the poem
 To underline to importance of poems, we decided to add all 8 runestones to the map, of which player can unlock 6 during a run


Second main point of the update is the map. While we got lots of positive feedback about the atmosphere of the game and the immersive feeling that the map achieves, most players thought that navigating the map was too difficult. Also, there is something hidden in the map that most of the players didn’t uncover. To tackle these things, we

 Added some landmarks to the map, hopefully making it easier to navigate
 Added a teaser about something hidden in the map ;)


Finally, while players seemed to enjoy the final boss quite a lot, there were also some things that definitely needed improving. Players pointed out that hitting the boss with the weapons was too difficult, and that the fight also needed a bit more of that “horde” element that’s usually present in games like this. So, according to the feedback, we decided to create a new mechanic for the boss fight

 The boss now spawns minions during the fight
 Damaging the minions also deal damage to the boss


We of course also fixed some bugs, added some quality of life and user experience improvements and as a surprise updated most of the normal enemy sprites with completely new animations!

After this update, we will keep this demo open for about a month to gather some new insights regarding the changes we made. Then we will close the demo and focus on creating some completely new content including new weapons, bosses, characters, progression and brand new mechanics! We will release another demo for the upcoming Steam Next Fest in the summer!

Thanks for being a part of the journey of Versebound, we hope that you’ll stay tuned!


Detailed patch notes

General balance

 Changed enemy spawn rates during the level
 Tweaked boss HP multipliers
 Tweaked various enemy stats
 Increased Lingonberry drop chance
 Reduced normal enemy collision damages
 Moderately increased player movement speed
 Slightly increased most enemy movement speeds

Balanced weapons

 Rye Loaf: Increased knockback force and reduced cooldown on all levels, increased damage on all but first level, increased bread durability on later levels
 Northland Bow: Decreased damage
 Vengeful Tears: Increased damage and trail length on all levels, shuffled some level up specs
 Knife of Kalervo: Increased damage on mid levels
 Hammer of Ilmarinen: Decreased cooldown on all levels
 Verses of Old: Reduced max rotation speed time, increased knockback force, slightly reduced damage
 Arrows of Ilmatar: Reduced damage and knockback force
 Broadsword of Ukko: Reduced damage and knockback force
 Ahti’s Force: Reduced projectile damage and cooldown, increased trail damage, trail slow amount and projectile knockback force
 Wrath of Ilmarinen: Reduced damage
 Blooms of Tuonela: Reduced damage

Balanced poems

 Poem of Recovery: Reduced HP regeneration rate
 Poem of Sturdiness: Reduced damage reduction amount
 Poem of Quickness: Increased cooldown reduction amount
 Poem of Reach: Now also affects interaction range (unlocking runestones and opening stone altar)
 Unlocking and leveling poems now also increase damage of all weapons

Updated enemy animations

 Both variants of Kyy (the snake)
 Both variants of Tonttu (the gnome)
 Both variants of Hiisi (the goblin)
 Both variants of Aave (the ghost)
 Hiisiemo (the goblin boss)

Other

 Increased the runestone amount in a the level from 4 to 8
 Added landmarks to the map
 Added a teaser of something hidden to the map
 The boss now spawns minions during the fight, damaging the minions also deal damage to the boss
 Aave, Strong Aave and Tulikko no longer collide with props (stones, stumps, etc)
 Bosses now spawn closer to the screen
 Added a visual and sound cue when a Bilberry spawns
 Added scary glowing eyes to Hiisiemo
 Updated the runestone arrow sprite to be more understandable
 Added a space bar icon on top of the stone altar when it is interactable
 Added a timer to the game screen
 Small text and other fixes
 Tweaked Knife of Kalervo to now hit the enemies touching the player
 Bug fix: level up / poem unlock / stone altar opening / death event could happen simultaneously
 Bug fix: enemies leaving Vengeful Tears trail might not revert back to original movement speed
 Bug fix: main menu buttons could be clicked before leaving the data consent panel
 Bug fix: Kyy (snake) sprites flicker when touching certain props
